lines.t: (Verse 1 – Female)
I’ve been walking through the ashes,
Of a fire I can’t forget.
Every prayer feels unanswered,
Every dream feels like regret.
But I hear You in the silence,
Like a whisper through my pain.
Telling me I’m not forgotten,
You still know my name.
(Chorus – Both)
You lift me when I’m breaking,
You hold me when I fall.
Your love’s the only reason
I can stand at all.
When I’m lost inside the darkness,
You’re the light that won’t give in—
You take what’s shattered,
And make me whole again.
My child, I saw you crying
When the world turned cold and blind. I’ve been calling through the stillness,
Just to bring you back to life.
Every tear that’s ever fallen,
I have counted, I have known.
You were never once abandoned—
You were never alone.
(Chorus – Both)
You lift me when I’m breaking,
You hold me when I fall.
Your love’s the only reason
I can stand at all.
When I’m lost inside the darkness,
You’re the light that won’t give in—
You take what’s shattered,
And make me whole again.
I thought You’d left me in the ruins,
But You were building something new.
Now I see the scars I carry
Are the proof I’m loved by You.
(Final Chorus – Both, soaring)
You lift me when I’m breaking,
You hold me when I fall.
Your love’s the fire that heals me,
And the voice that breaks the wall.
When I’m lost inside the darkness,
You’re the light that won’t give in—
You take what’s shattered,
And make me whole again.
(Outro – soft duet)
Whole again…
In Your hands, I’m whole again.
